title: Noteblock Minecarts
description: Turns a Music Score into Minecarts
body:
## Adds a block that generate minecarts based on a real music score.

# How to use:

**1. Download a score with MusicXML (.mxl) format**

**2. Drag the file to the file path given by "Add Score" button in Piano Block**

**3. Click "Load Score"**

**(Survival Mode only) (4. Insert 64 Minecart with Noteblock in the slot given in Piano Block)**

**5. Select Score, click "Play"**

**Note: Minecart with Noteblock will only play a note when it's on activator rail, a sample of rail system is given in the figures.**
